title: First prompt after accepting trust can go out without SessionStart context
observed: After the trust dialog was accepted, internal/cli/tui.go ran the deferred SessionStart hooks on a goroutine of their own and sent their output later as MsgStartupContext. A prompt submitted before that message landed went out without the hook context; test/e2e/trust_test.go hid it with a 500ms sleep. Esc could not stop the hooks.
expected: The prompt waits for the SessionStart hooks (busy line 'Running session start hooks', the prompt queues) and goes out with their context; Esc stops them and puts the queued prompt back in the input, as for /compact.
evidence: TestTUI_Trust_HooksAndAllowWaitForTrust with a 1s SessionStart hook fails on the old code: 'the first prompt lacks the SessionStart context'.
TestTrustedSessionStart_PromptWaitsForContext fails without the background operation; TestTrustedSessionStart_EscStopsHooks fails with a no-op cancel.
